_source: Catalogue row of the construction register (docs/design/v5.3-c-register.md). capacity = the French start stock's mean enrolment per lycee (data/units/stock/FRA.json: 2 142 289 pupils over 3 541 lycees = 605), in the stock's own unit, enrolled pupils, until Design's amendment D2 sets the sizing rule (the catalogue has one capacity for every nation: Germany's mean is 345). STAND-IN numbers, none sourced: every figure marked below is the game's declared placeholder until the author's table of stand-ins (spec section 12). cost_eur_m: stand-in of 0.0575 M EUR per pupil, the middle of the press-release anchor of 52 to 69 M EUR for a lycee of 900 to 1 200 places (not verified); a bounded search for a Cour des comptes or regional council deliberation, the UK DfE National School Delivery Cost Benchmarking and a Landesrechnungshof report found no per-pupil figure. running_eur_m: stand-in of 9 000 EUR per pupil a year. staff: stand-in of 90 jobs. build_months, overrun_odds, overrun_share, demolish_months, demolish_cost_share, band_units: the spec's stand-ins (sections 5, 7, 12). figure_elasticity: -1 by the spec (more places, fewer pupils per teacher). bloc_offset_per_pop_share: stand-in.
name: Upper secondary school
